relationships.evidence_quote: Here, we first demonstrated natural existence of SPN-protein phosphatase 1-Rac1 complex in the spinal dorsal horn (DH) neurons by both double immunofluorescent labeling and co-immunoprecipitation

key_findings: SPN forms a complex with PP1 and Rac1 in dorsal horn neurons.
SPN overexpression blocks bee-venom pain hypersensitivity and lowers GTP-Rac1-ERK; knockdown raises pain, Rac1-ERK activity and spine density.
